genre. A kind or style of music, movies or books.
dislike. To not like someone or something.
like. To enjoy something or think it is nice.
actor. A person who acts in movies, plays or TV shows.
athlete. A person who is good at sports and competes in them.
read. To look at words and understand them.
math. The study of numbers and shapes.
ride. To sit on something and travel on it.
outdoor. Happening outside, not in a building.
